clue.text: Dish cut into pieces, the old American recalled

parts.note: to chop is to cut into pieces

indicators.note: to recall is to call back, so these letters are brought back the other way round

parts.note: ye is an archaic spelling of the
US is the standard abbreviation for American

explanation.surface: A dish chopped into bits, remembered by some old American.
explanation.definitionFit: Chop suey is a Chinese-American stir-fried dish, so it is a dish served at table.

clue.text: Select sweet with no centre

indicators.note: having no centre means the middle letter of the word is taken out

parts.note: a choc ice is an ice-cream bar coated in chocolate

explanation.surface: Pick out a sweet that has no filling in the middle.
explanation.walkthrough: A choc ice is a British ice-cream bar with a chocolate coating; drop its central C.
explanation.definitionFit: Choice works as an adjective meaning of top quality, just as select does.

clue.text: One may be this, on and after a wayzgoose!

definitions.text: One may be this, on and after a wayzgoose!

parts.words: One may be this, on and after a wayzgoose!
parts.note: surface reading: a puzzle about what state someone is in at an odd-sounding event
setter's reading: a wayzgoose is a printers' annual outing and party, so going on one means seeking enjoyment

explanation.walkthrough: A wayzgoose is an old word for a printing works' annual summer outing with feasting; anyone on one is both out on a trip and having fun.
explanation.definitionFit: To be out for a good time is to be seeking pleasure, which is what an annual works party offers.

clue.text: Frenchman's material

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a common French man's first name
second meaning: a hard-wearing twilled fabric

explanation.walkthrough: The possessive makes it look like cloth belonging to a Frenchman; really it is two separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a French given name and a durable woollen twill used for suits and uniforms.

clue.text: Prom in Naples crumbling, notice, close to landing-stage

indicators.note: something crumbling falls apart, so the town's letters break up and re-form

parts.note: taken as written
an ad is a notice, an advertisement

indicators.note: the close of a word is its end, so only its final letter is taken

parts.note: the last letter of landing-stage

explanation.surface: A seafront walk in Naples is falling apart, a sign reads, near the jetty.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed answer ESPLANDEE is a misprint; the wordplay gives ESPLANADE. Prom is short for promenade.
explanation.definitionFit: An esplanade is a long open level walkway, especially along a seafront, which is what a prom is.

clue.text: Large rug packed initially into battered crate

indicators.note: into says one piece goes inside another
something battered is knocked out of shape, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word just before it

parts.note: the first letter of packed

explanation.surface: A big rug was stuffed first into a damaged packing crate.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpet is a heavy floor covering, often fitted wall to wall, so a large rug is a fair description.

clue.text: A novel type of mullein

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a 1922 novel by D. H. Lawrence
second meaning: a tall yellow-flowered plant also called great mullein

explanation.walkthrough: 'A novel type' reads as 'a new kind', but 'A novel' is one book and 'type of mullein' a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Aaron's Rod is the title of a D. H. Lawrence novel and a folk name for the great mullein plant.

clue.text: Critical part of flight, up front, in one to Russia's capital, possibly

parts.note: surface reading: the stage of an air journey after which a plane must go on

parts.words: up front, in one to Russia's capital, possibly
parts.note: setter's reading: the front spot in a one-way ticket to Moscow, a trip with nothing booked back

explanation.surface: Somewhere up at the front of a plane bound for Moscow, the crucial moment of the flight arrives.
explanation.walkthrough: A one-way journey to Moscow has no return leg, and 'up front' suggests a point, the leading position.
explanation.definitionFit: In aviation this is the stage beyond which a plane lacks fuel to get back, so it is the critical moment of a flight.

clue.text: Kojak to be promoted? That's conjecture

parts.note: Theo Kojak is the bald detective of the 1970s TV series
to rise is to be promoted

explanation.surface: A TV detective earning promotion is just speculation.
explanation.walkthrough: Kojak's first name is Theo, from the American police show starring Telly Savalas.
explanation.definitionFit: To theorise is to form ideas without proof, which is what conjecturing means.

clue.text: Quickly read through second Kipling novel

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for second
Kim is Rudyard Kipling's 1901 novel

explanation.surface: Skimming a second book by Kipling at speed.
explanation.definitionFit: To skim a text is to glance over it rapidly for the gist, reading it quickly.

clue.text: Water creature scoundrel beheaded

indicators.note: beheading removes the head, so the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a rotter is a cad, a scoundrel

explanation.surface: A river animal and a villain who lost his head.
explanation.definitionFit: An otter is a fish-eating mammal living in rivers, so it is an aquatic animal.

clue.text: Game — card game with daughter leading diamonds

parts.note: poker is a card game
D is the abbreviation for daughter
ice is slang for diamonds

explanation.surface: A game: a card game where the daughter leads with diamonds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Leading' simply places the daughter before the diamonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Poker dice is a dice game scoring hands like those in poker, so it is a game.

clue.text: Reportedly catch a contagious disease

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said, so we want what the words sound like spoken

parts.note: to collar someone is to catch them

explanation.surface: It is said you can pick up an infectious illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Cholera is a bacterial infection spread through dirty water, a highly contagious disease.

clue.text: Clergyman sacrificing second one in church

indicators.note: to sacrifice something is to give it up, so a letter is removed

parts.note: a minister is a clergyman
the second I, one being I in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: A priest giving something up in his church.
explanation.definitionFit: A minster is a large or important church, often one that grew from a monastery, like York Minster.

clue.text: Scan draft star prepared for a movement inspired by Ruskin

indicators.note: something prepared has been made ready and worked over, so these letters are set out anew

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Checking a celebrity's script got ready for some artistic cause.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed answer has a D for the second A; the anagram gives ARTS AND CRAFTS.
explanation.definitionFit: The Arts and Crafts movement of the later 1800s championed handmade design, drawing on John Ruskin's ideas about labour and beauty.

clue.text: A private conversation first of all between two Parisian heads

indicators.note: between puts one piece in the middle of the two either side

parts.note: tête is French for head, twice over

indicators.note: the first of the word all is its opening letter

parts.note: the opening letter of all

explanation.surface: A confidential chat, first and foremost between two people in Paris.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First of all' reads as 'above all', but it takes the first letter of 'all'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tête-à-tête, literally head to head, is an intimate talk between two people.

clue.text: Left flat with one before noon and called round

parts.note: to drop a partner is to leave them flat, abandon them
I is the Roman numeral for one
N is the abbreviation for noon

explanation.surface: Someone left their flat with somebody before midday and paid a visit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flat' looks like an apartment, but 'left flat' means jilted.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop in is to pay a casual visit, the same as calling round.

clue.text: In the wings, adjust to gaffes

indicators.note: to adjust is to alter, so the following letters are changed in order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Waiting in the wings, an actor reacts to blunders.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in the wings means standing just out of sight beside the stage, hidden from the audience.

clue.text: Where Monopoly players have had to start ever since its creation?

parts.words: Where Monopoly players have had to start
parts.note: surface reading: the starting square on the Monopoly board is labelled with a short command
setter's reading: an idiom for right from the very beginning

explanation.surface: Monopoly players have always had to start at the same spot, since the game was invented.
explanation.walkthrough: Every Monopoly game begins on the corner square marked GO.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means from the very outset, so it describes something true since its beginning.

clue.text: Right in favour of exercises before runs

parts.note: pro means in favour of
PE is physical education, school exercises
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Supporting exercise before a run is the correct approach.
explanation.definitionFit: Proper and right are synonyms meaning fitting or correct.

clue.text: Admires astonishing weapon

indicators.note: something astonishing knocks things sideways, so the letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone gazes in admiration at an amazing gun.
explanation.definitionFit: A sidearm is a weapon such as a pistol carried at the waist.

clue.text: Despicable fellow injecting drug

indicators.note: injecting puts a substance inside, so one piece goes into another

parts.note: a man is a fellow
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A contemptible man shooting up drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Mean can describe someone low and contemptible, a sense close to despicable.

clue.text: Nobleman pinning one on trailblazer

indicators.note: pinning holds something within, so one piece is gripped inside another

parts.note: a peer is a nobleman
I is the Roman numeral for one
taken as written

explanation.surface: A lord pins a medal on an explorer.
explanation.definitionFit: A pioneer is the first to open up new ground, just like a trailblazer.

clue.text: Waste matter spoilt a lake

parts.note: food that has gone off is spoilt
taken as written
L is the abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: Pollution has ruined a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Offal means entrails and offcuts of a carcass, and by extension refuse or waste.

clue.text: Girl fronting group getting ribbon for hair

parts.note: Alice is a girl's name
a band is a musical group

explanation.surface: A girl leading a pop group is given a hair ribbon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fronting' simply puts the girl's name first.
explanation.definitionFit: An Alice band is a flexible hairband worn over the head, named after Tenniel's drawings of Alice.

clue.text: Prime piece of fillet steak for dowdy woman

indicators.note: the prime piece is the first part, so only the opening letter is taken

parts.note: the opening letter of fillet
rump is a cut of steak

explanation.surface: The best cut of beef is wasted on a dowdy woman.
explanation.definitionFit: A frump is an unfashionable, drab-looking woman.

clue.text: Time for morning coffee in the Spanish square?

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
to be square is to be even, all debts settled

explanation.surface: Coffee break time in a Spanish town square.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a mid-morning snack is called elevenses, taken at about eleven o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: Eleven o'clock is the traditional hour for a British mid-morning coffee break, elevenses.

clue.text: Witty remark about eastern passenger ship

parts.note: on means about, concerning
E is the abbreviation for eastern
a liner is a large passenger ship

explanation.surface: A clever quip about an ocean liner in the East.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-liner is a short joke or quip delivered in a single sentence.
